purpose: Complete parameter-development records consolidated without changing original objects or their internal stage-specific hashes.

record.reason: An oblique fixed-detector model also needs angle-dependent parallax tolerance; compare this with source-slab shear instead of forcing a 90-degree shift range on oblique views.
record.shift_rule: Base (vertical,horizontal)=(27,20) working pixels. Add ceil((17.5 mm*tan(abs(factor*(nominal_angle-90))))/(0.035 mm*6)) only along the model axis projected onto the detector. Cap at floor(0.45*image_dimension).
record.assumptions: The 0.035 mm sampling and unit magnification provide a heuristic working scale, not measured object-space calibration. All candidates receive identical searches.
record.axis_mapping: Source axis0 is image horizontal; source axis1 is image vertical.
record.previous_stage: V1 pilot results retained separately. V2 was developed without inspecting heldout retrieval metrics; this is not immutable preregistration.
record.primary_geometry_rule: Highest pilot mean Top-1 over the four new angles; tie lower mean rank, then model order.

record.source_slab: crop origin k through k+retained_shape_k; expanded in-plane source context sampled by oblique rays
record.fixed_detector_projection: P(i,j) = mean_k V_source(i + tan(phi)*(k-k_center), j, k) for axis0, or shift j for axis1; phi = sign*factor*(nominal_angle-90 degrees)
record.geometry_selection_rule: Highest pilot mean Top-1 across the FOUR new angles; tie: lower mean rank, then model list order. 90-degree scores are held fixed across models.
record.primary_reporting: Held-out query records (folds 1-4); also show full-release descriptive results and development results separately.
record.candidate_sets: Frozen 20 candidates, unchanged across all angle/model/fusion comparisons.
record.source_context_comparison: Adjusted oblique descriptors use source context, whereas the legacy reference uses local crops; any improvement reflects this combined adjustment, not an isolated effect of angle alone.
record.scope: Uncalibrated nominal-angle source-slab retrieval. Not calibrated DRR, registration-error validation, or independent external validation. Legacy NCC parameters were developed on some release records.
